notes: P04 task SACMAT-candidate (PolicyTrace RQ1-RQ3): temporal conformance testing candidate. evaluation/venue2027/sacmat/candidate.py implements conformance_test(trace, engines) -> ConformanceResult: ONE delegated-consent trace is replayed through MULTIPLE heterogeneous in-process policy-engine models over LOGICAL time (state events GRANT/REVOKE/DELEGATE applied tick by tick; every ACCESS tick evaluates every engine) and the FIRST pairwise divergence is reported with the EXACT logical timestamp and the two disagreeing engines plus both decisions (TEMPORAL_CONFORMANCE_DIVERGENCE; four-valued vocabulary PERMIT/DENY/NOT_APPLICABLE/INDETERMINATE). Engine models implement pinned upstreams' documented semantics with mismatched portability surfaces: cedar (Cedar v4.14.1: permit/forbid set, forbid precedence, expiry caller-encoded and NOT honored), openfga (Zanzibar ATC 2019 / OpenFGA v1.22.1: relation-tuple walk at read time, expired/revoked tuples absent, two-valued check) and opa (fail-closed temporal evaluation: lapsed delegation is an explicit DENY). The divergence class detected is structurally invisible to static diffs and single-engine tests: a delegation expiring between grant and access whose terminal state is later healed — cedar permits at the expiry tick while openfga denies, and every terminal-state view agrees again. Ablations prove each component load-bearing: ablation_single_engine (same replay, ONE engine: no pairwise comparison, misses the divergence with ABLATION_SINGLE_ENGINE_NO_COMPARISON) and ablation_no_time (all engines, terminal state only: access decision time and intermediate ticks discarded, misses the healed divergence with ABLATION_NO_TIME_TERMINAL_VIEW_ONLY while still catching unhealed divergence). describe_mechanism() emits the JSON-serializable mechanism description (components, engine semantics, ablations, witness form). Harness adapter run_candidate(case, ctx) -> Outcome maps DIVERGENCE->REJECT / NO_DIVERGENCE->ADMIT (both counted_as_success=True) and malformed cases -> INDETERMINATE (never counted, never a silent safe rejection); simulate_unavailable_upstream returns NOT_RUN_EXTERNAL / BASELINE_UNAVAILABLE (never counted, retriable). Wiring errors (unknown engine, non-sequence engines, unrecognized trace input, non-mapping case) raise TemporalConformanceError with stable reason codes; data faults (empty trace, missing logical time, unordered/duplicate timestamps, unsupported constructs, malformed DELEGATE) are first-class INDETERMINATE results. No wall clock, randomness, network or I/O; determinism asserted byte-identical. Machine-checked: 26 new tests pass (positive: conformant trace NO_DIVERGENCE with full-timeline agreement, expiry divergence at EXACT tick 2500 with cedar-vs-openfga witness, revoked-source delegation divergence NOT_APPLICABLE-vs-DENY at tick 1000, delegation-chain agreement, run_candidate mapping, NOT_RUN_EXTERNAL, determinism, describe_mechanism; adversarial: ablation_single_engine MISSES the expiry divergence for every single engine, ablation_no_time MISSES the healed divergence (terminal tick 3000, all engines PERMIT) yet still catches the unhealed variant, composed ablation misses, insufficient/duplicate engines INDETERMINATE, malformed-trace battery, wiring-error reason codes, to_dict round trip); full evaluation/venue2027 suite 1403 passed; ruff check + format clean on touched files. Oracle independence: candidate imports no oracle module and the verdict derives from pairwise engine disagreement only. source_sha_after = commit HEAD at proof-emission time.
